name: ag-ide-prompt-enhancer
description: Adds an Enhance Prompt button, customizable keyboard shortcut, and settings in Antigravity IDE while preserving @mentions and attachments.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check enhance-ide-hook.js && node --check scripts/package-vsix.mjs && node --check scripts/release.mjs && node --check scripts/auto-bump-on-commit.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run verify:contracts
scripts.build: npm run verify && npm run package

commands.title: Prompt Enhancer: Reinstall / Repair IDE UI Hook
Prompt Enhancer: Show Diagnostics & Health Check

antigravityPromptEnhancer.shortcutEnable.description: Enable keyboard shortcut trigger inside the Antigravity chat input box.

antigravityPromptEnhancer.shortcut.description: Custom keyboard shortcut to trigger Enhance Prompt directly inside the chat input box (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+E, Alt+Shift+E).

antigravityPromptEnhancer.outputLanguage.description: Preferred language for enhanced prompts: auto (preserve draft language), id (Indonesian), or en (English).

antigravityPromptEnhancer.detailLevel.description: Detail level of the rewritten prompt: concise (1-3 sentences), balanced (compact & token-efficient), or comprehensive (thorough high-signal bullets).

antigravityPromptEnhancer.preset.description: Enhancement mode preset: general, debug (bug fix & reproduction), refactor (cleanup & safety), or architecture (design & plan).

antigravityPromptEnhancer.customInstruct.description: Optional concise extra instructions appended when enhancing prompts (max 400 characters).

antigravityPromptEnhancer.includeWorkspa.description: Include active workspace folders, manifests, and open editor tabs when enhancing prompts.

antigravityPromptEnhancer.includeConvers.description: Include recent messages from the active chat thread to resolve contextual references.

antigravityPromptEnhancer.showToast.description: Show subtle status toast feedback inside the chat panel when enhancement completes or fails.

antigravityPromptEnhancer.proxyPort.description: Preferred loopback port for the local iframe proxy and enhance endpoint (falls back to an ephemeral port if busy). Overridden by AGY_ENHANCER_PORT.

antigravityPromptEnhancer.cliPath.description: Optional path to the native Antigravity CLI binary. Overridden by AGY_CLI_BIN.

antigravityPromptEnhancer.timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for running agy -p during prompt enhancement. Overridden by AGY_ENHANCER_TIMEOUT_MS.
